from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document extracted from the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The official title or case name of the judgment document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The procedural stage or type of document, e.g., 'Civil Appeal', 'Administrative Review'")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action or legal nature described in the document, e.g., 'Administrative Registration', 'Patent Infringement'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
